Selected work

Aug 2026

Oil Spill Detection System

  • Engineered a U-Net pipeline that slides a 256×256 window over large SAR satellite scenes to detect and segment oil spills.
  • Converted masks into spill polygons, area and coordinates, then matched AIS vessel data to trigger early pollution alerts.
  • Exposed the trained model through FastAPI endpoints with Swagger docs, and a Next.js OceanX dashboard for viewing detections.
  • Trained 10 epochs (BCE+Dice loss) on 1,000 / 200 samples, scoring IoU, Dice, Precision and Recall at 0.4–0.7 thresholds.

Jul 2026

Farmer Crop Advisory System

  • Designed a MERN platform that analyzes local weather and soil data to recommend the most suitable crop for each farm.
  • Integrated an OpenAI chatbot so farmers without easy expert access get instant guidance on crops and farming queries.
  • Built React.js screens backed by Express.js APIs and MongoDB, so farmers get crop advice and AI chat support.
  • Connected 3 layers (React, Node.js, MongoDB) through REST APIs, combining 2 data inputs (weather, soil) with AI chat.

Apr 2026

EcoPickup – Smart Waste Management

  • Developed a role-based platform where users book waste pickups, workers collect them and admins oversee operations.
  • Streamlined collection by tracking every request through a validated workflow on live Leaflet.js location maps.
  • Modeled users, pickup requests and status updates in MongoDB, serving each role dashboard via Express.js REST APIs.
  • Deployed on Vercel with 3 roles and a 5-stage pickup workflow, secured with JWT auth tokens and bcrypt hashing.
